subject: Q1 close — proposed credit acceleration for BridgePoint
body:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time credit for BridgePoint close this quarter

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Quick ask — BridgePoint AI is at the finish line for a 12-month Dedicated commitment (estimated ARR $240k). Legal and procurement are responsive, but the CFO asked if we can provide a short conversion incentive to get signatures before EOD 3/31. The prospect is price-sensitive to token consumption in the first 60 days of usage; they said a clear credit makes the internal approval go faster.

Summary:
- Customer: BridgePoint AI (Katy Rogers)
- Proposed incentive: $5,000 platform credit applied to first invoice + 60-day trial extension on their sandbox (to preserve eval footprint)
- Rationale: Clears finance blocking item; high probability to close this week; long-term ARR and usage profile favorable
- Risk: One-time credit, non-recurring, contingent on signed order by 2026-03-31

Can we get green light to offer this? If approved I will send the credit addendum and DocuSign link to procurement and CC you. I attached the latest usage snapshot for context.

Thanks — Soojin

Attachment: usage_report_Mar2026.csv (CSV, 48KB)

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time credit for BridgePoint close this quarter

Soojin — approved with two conditions:
1) Credit must be non-recurring and applied only to their first invoice; we add explicit language in the addendum.
2) Sales confirms expected first-3-month token burn in-line with the usage snapshot and adds a success plan milestone (CS to own).

Ben — can you confirm finance can process a $5k contra and that it won't require a multi-signature? If yes, I'll sign off and Marissa approves.

Marissa

---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Katy Rogers <katy@bridgepoint.ai>
Cc: procurement@bridgepoint.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated — final commercial and credit addendum

Katy — great to hear we're close. Per our conversation, we can provide a one-time $5,000 platform credit applied to your first invoice and extend the sandbox access by 60 days to let your integration team ramp. This offer is contingent on the signed order by 2026-03-31 and will be captured in a short addendum.

What I will do now:
- Attach short credit addendum (PDF) to the order and send DocuSign link
- CC procurement and finance for billing/setup
- Share an initial 30/60/90 success plan with CS after signature

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/contracts/secure/abc123
Addendum attached: credit_addendum_BP.pdf

Please confirm the invoice billing address and if procurement needs any additional paperwork. If you can sign today we will expedite on our side and target a 4/1 activation.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138

Attachment: credit_addendum_BP.pdf (PDF, 12 pages)

---
From: Katy Rogers <katy@bridgepoint.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bridgepoint.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated — final commercial and credit addendum

Soojin — thanks, that works for us. We appreciate the flexibility. A few quick items from procurement before sending to final signature:
- Please include the exact invoice/billing address: BridgePoint AI, AP Dept, 420 Market St #12, San Francisco, CA 94104
- Our legal wants the credit to be described as a one-time billing credit (not a rebate) and the effective date tied to the invoice date; can you confirm the wording will reflect that?
- We accept DocuSign; our PO number will be provided in the purchase order that follows signature.

If you can update the addendum with the billing address and the credit language, procurement will countersign today. Please send updated DocuSign link.

—Katy
VP Product, BridgePoint AI
katy@bridgepoint.ai
